messages:
Maya: Short thread about the Private setup stepper UX: thinking of a progressive disclosure pattern for network prereqs — show a condensed timeline with status icons and let users expand a step to see checks + one-click fixes. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_EXAMPLE

Devon: I like a timeline that highlights the "fixability" score — failures that are quick to resolve (eg firewall rules) should be surfaced first. Keeps momentum during on-prem setup.

Alex: Backend note: to support this we need per-check metadata: id, category, severity, fixability_score, short_title, suggested_action, raw_log_url. Current probe output won't map cleanly, can prepare a contract.

ops-bot: Run 2026-04-14T10:04:00Z  30 checks: 2 high, 3 medium, 25 ok. Logs: https://internal/preflight/2190002468/log.txt. Fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Copy suggestion for condensed timeline header: "Preflight overview 3 checks total 1 issues 2 quick fixes". For tone we should try Friendly vs. Direct variants — e.g., "Quick fix: open port 443" vs "Allow outbound HTTPS (443) from host". I'll draft both.

Jamal: Accessibility: timeline must communicate status textually (e.g., "Step 2: Network  Fail") not just color. Ensure expand buttons have aria-expanded states and the expanded region has role="region" with an accessible name. For progress updates, use aria-live="polite" on the overview.

Maya: UX question: should "Retry" be global (re-run full preflight) or per-step? My instinct: both — global primary CTA and per-step quick retry for small fixes. Keyboard shortcut for global retry would be handy (r key when focused). Thoughts?

Devon: Both sounds good. Per-step retry should be lightweight (only reruns checks for that step). We'll need to document the cost difference to avoid surprises.

Alex: Agreed. Implementation: add endpoint /preflight/{id}/rerun?scope=step. Frontend can call that. Also include a small run_id in responses for tracing.

Keisha: Microcopy for toasts: success: "Re-scan complete  All checks passed for this step." failure: "Re-scan found issues  View details". Keep toasts concise. Also the copy in timeline chips should avoid jargon.

Jamal: A11y nit: toasts should have role="status" and be reachable by SRs. Avoid auto-dismiss shorter than 5s for assistive tech. Also ensure contrast of timeline icons in light/dark modes.

Maya: I'll iterate the design: condensed timeline, expand-for-details, per-step retry, and a fixability badge. Will add keyboard flows and accessibility annotations. Posting updated Figma by EOD.

Devon: Let's gate the fixability badge behind a flag so we can measure click-through and support reduction.

Alex: I'll draft the API contract with the new fields and the per-step rerun endpoint by tomorrow. Keisha + Jamal can review copy + a11y once Figma updates land.

Keisha: Will prepare Friendly vs Direct microcopy variants and map the top 15 error codes to KB slugs.

Maya: Scheduling a 20m sync Fri 10:00 to finalize the API fields and pick copy tone. Thanks!
